clips.title: The story
paras: Elaine Carevin in Darkshire sends you to check on Abercrombie, an elderly recluse who has not come to town for provisions. He lives in a rickety shack at the edge of Raven Hill Cemetery.

Elaine Carevin remembers an old man who came to Darkshire for provisions, then stopped appearing. With danger on Duskwood’s roads, she asks you to visit his shack by Raven Hill Cemetery and see whether he is safe.

At the shack, you find Abercrombie alive. He chuckles at the Carevins’ concern and says age and the monsters in the woods have kept him from town. Glad to have an able traveler at his door, he quickly asks for help with a few errands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Elaine Carevin? Hehe, oh yes... Of course, the Carevins.
No, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. Maybe you can do an old man some favors?
